subject: fix(gdn): order fresh-state prefill output reads

requirement.failure: Fresh-state Xe2 GDN prefill must not read another subgroup's not-yet-published O2 values when computing O2 times U. The local patch orders those writes before the fresh-state output GEMM, addressing nondeterministic/corrupt fresh-state output described by the existing fork rationale.
requirement.workload: Intel B70/Xe2 Qwen3.8-27B BF16 GDN, K16/V48/D128 at TP1, including fresh requests under the eager V2/DFlash2 profile. The recurrent prefill kernel uses 64-token chunks; local coverage brackets the boundary and exercises longer fresh-state and continuation cases.
requirement.final_stack_behavior: The barrier-containing source blob at this commit is identical at final old tip 05d4536b2440db171741b5de5c148cdc834bd692. No subsequent repair or revert cancels this behavior.
requirement.scope: Correctness synchronization, not a speed optimization or a claim of whole-model deterministic output. The asynchronous regression also covers workspace lifetime and neighboring oneDNN projection behavior.

upstream_coverage.selected_base_evidence: The selected kernel base is unchanged. At lines 1086-1087, subgroups copy their O2 fragments to the global A/O2 workspace. The fresh-state branch at line 1214 reaches gemm_TTS(O2_tensor, U_tensor_T, ...) without a workgroup barrier after those writes.
upstream_coverage.alternate_synchronization: The start-of-chunk WAR barrier and SLM-publication barrier occur before O2 production. The later U_new barrier is inside has_prev_state and is not executed for a fresh first chunk. Intervening state GEMMs and stores are not a cross-subgroup publication barrier. has_prev_state is computed from uniform chunk_id and per-batch initial_state, so the added group barrier is on a workgroup-uniform branch.
upstream_coverage.newer_release_evidence: The complete file has identical blob b457f3d06213cf141dfed99d0ed1a6a4b387dc7f at both upstream ddf336d86e3c8602888572a3502f951abd51df12 and v0.1.17 6a1ec18b69b00eaf67a457e0bdd40e72632feaae. No commits in that upstream interval change this file. The later GDN NULL-state guard, DS convolution layout and RecoverSSM changes do not alter the fresh-state O2 producer/consumer ordering.
upstream_coverage.decision: No equivalent synchronization or removal of the affected path exists in either examined upstream kernel version.

upstream_coverage.evidence: v0.33 adds selectable Triton/SYCL GDN execution, but auto still selects sycl when _xpu_C.gdn_attention is built. forward_xpu then invokes gdn_attention_core_xpu. In both kernel targets, non-spec prefill on Xe2 selects chunk_gated_delta_rule_xe2 and ultimately chunk_fwd_o_kernel. v0.1.17 retains this selection at gdn_attn_interface.cpp lines 810-833.
upstream_coverage.decision: Optional Triton execution avoids the native site only when explicitly selected. It does not repair or retire the supported/default SYCL route and does not justify dropping the barrier.

minimum_residual.production: Retain sycl::group_barrier(item.get_group()) immediately inside if (!has_prev_state), before the output dv loop. Preserve upstream U_new and next-chunk synchronization. No additional API or schema change is needed.
minimum_residual.tests: Retain the existing replay, batch-separability, canonical-boundary continuation and asynchronous-chain regressions. They cover observable native behavior beyond source-text checks; no new test or broad refactor is needed for an unchanged kernel base.

dependencies.relationship: Preceding untiled-convolution workaround addresses another stage of the fused GDN path. Replacing or removing that workaround does not remove this output-GEMM synchronization requirement.

The asynchronous end-to-end native regression includes int4_gemm_w4a16 projections, so its bitwise layer-output checks also rely on the separate deterministic oneDNN policy. The two-line production synchronization fix itself has no dependency on the oneDNN implementation.
Later mixed-batch split changes dispatch but leaves this header unchanged. Fresh prefills still need the barrier even when ordinary cached decodes are separated.

Verified exact upstream-file blob equality through v0.1.17 and exact local-file equality from assigned commit through final old tip.

Run test_qwen38_gdn_t107_async_chain_is_exact on the candidate native closure to exercise queued non-default-stream calls and exact workspace-shape churn.
Run the actual Qwen/DFlash serving/cache qualification after the operator maintenance handoff. Passing the native regression does not establish deterministic text generation for the whole model.
validation.comparison_if_removal_is_proposed: Compare patched and upstream-only kernels on identical toolchain/input/stream conditions. Repeated passing executions alone cannot prove absence of this source-level inter-subgroup race; require a changed ordering or execution design before removing the synchronization.
validation.performance_claim: None. No controlled barrier-cost comparison or new serving measurement was run; retain the existing correctness requirement.
